newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers leap $6, Med steady, buying poor.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers leap $6, Med steady, buying poor.

text.p: ARA bunkers prices raced up some $6 a tonne on Friday after a trading house began concerted barge buying, while Mediterranean prices were steady, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST was up some $6 a tonne to $122/$123 as one trading house consistently bought up barges. ARA demand, however, was poor, after many shipowners had bought midweek. Some suppliers said prices would rise further next week.
Hamburg prices ticked up by about $2 a tonne in response to the Rotterdam strength. Enquiries were sparse and resultant demand lacklustre.

Mediterranean prices were mostly steady and demand was slack. Exceptions to this rule were Spain, where shipowners rushed in for a spot of pre-weekend buying and France, where supply problems in the south resulted in slightly higher prices.
Fujairah prices were substantially lower at $106/$108, but gained a little from the early session. Brokers said two buyers were aggressively selling material.
